profile.headline: Software Engineer @ PayPal
profile.summary:
Im a full stack developer with professional development experience from building out entire admin tools utilizing typescript and react on the frontend, building scalable atomic scripts using python via cron jobs and server side architecture leveraging go.

I have a passion for problem solving and I make it my mission to find the most elegant solutions I possibly can. In the projects I’ve lead, I’ve made sure to not leave any rocks unturned when it comes to fleshing out expectations and planning for the future.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Played a pivotal role in the migration process of billions of links to a more modern framework through the development of resilient solutions utilizing Go, Python, and React.

- Migrated multiple feature areas from legacy platforms into a single unified admin center, primarily using React. This greatly simplified the customer’s ability to manage their service environments by requiring they use a single admin site rather than three.

- Engineered and maintained three administrative tools using React, React Query, and TypeScript from inception to deployment. These tools played a critical role in overseeing Dropbox Business teams, accommodating over 20,000 teams from startup to enterprise.

- Led a high-impact project to integrate a new version of the company’s web page across the full tech stack, ensuring seamless operation alongside the existing version for active users. This involved coordinating with cross-functional teams, overseeing the deployment process, and managing the dual-version environment to ensure stability and performance.

- Designed and executed a comprehensive experiment strategy, which included A/B testing, real-time user monitoring, and iterative feedback loops. Implemented features and enhancements while maintaining backward compatibility, resulting in a significant 400% increase in user activation rates
